First time
The first time I took ritalin was a few weeks ago....I had to study for a very big test and my gf told me she used to take them to make it easier to concentrate and stay awake... Boy was she right..I picked up that book and didnt put it down for 3 hours straight..didnt get bored and remembered almost every topic I read....It was a very good experience I have to say...the only bad part is the next morning ughhhh. Its like a bad groggy hang over....I can fix it if I pop another ritalin although I wouldnt do it too much its kind of addicting...I'm actually on 100mg right now as I'm writing this I had to study for another test....but if I'm not using it for studying I feel it makes it easy to talk in front of people and organize my thoughts clearly....also towards the end of the trip my stomach will feel kinda funny like theres alot of air in it...not too bad though...I love doing it....I snort by the way...
